title: The Rubber Duck Conspiracy
skyStory: Aquarius, the water bearer, tips its jug across the sky and the moon, nine tenths full, sloshes about happily. Somewhere in the stream of starlight floats a tiny yellow shape that the astronomers refuse to comment on. Uranus winks. Saturn is drafting a stern memo about loose bath toys in orbit. The memo will not help. The ducks are already deployed.

reading: Sunday at the cabin should be slow, and the universe is arranging for that, mostly by sending you an absurd distraction. At some point today you will find a rubber duck somewhere a rubber duck has no business being: a parking lot, a mailbox, the top of a fence post. Do not ask questions. Take a photo.

Here is the part you will not believe. Nancy will find one too, on the same day, in an equally ridiculous spot. The two ducks will not have met. They will not need to. Don't even scream. The [[Two of Cups]] just likes proving that two people in two places can laugh at the identical silly thing within hours of each other.
joel.mission: Leave a small cheerful surprise somewhere for a stranger to find: a doodle, a note, a painted rock.
joel.omen: Anything yellow and bobbing. The universe is in a playful mood; play back.

reading: The Wood Rat spots it first, obviously. Something small and yellow sitting very seriously where it should not be. You will smile before you even understand why. Then your phone will buzz, and there it is: Joel's duck, staring at you through the screen like an old accomplice.

Call it. ΔΕΣ. Then let the rest of your Sunday be just as playful. Wander somewhere you have not been in a while. Say yes to the odd invitation. The [[Page of Cups]] has a fish in her teacup and a grin on her face, and today she is in charge of your schedule.
nancy.mission: Give a found object an elaborate backstory in three sentences and send it to Joel as breaking news.
nancy.omen: A second rubber duck. The joke has a sequel, and the sequel is better.

together.text: Name both ducks and write their joint biography in five sentences, one of which must contain a heist. Decide which duck is the mastermind. DES has now been officially catalogued in the Aquarian Archive of Absurdity, shelf eleven, right next to the blinking gadget.

game.intro: DES alert: the rubber ducks are organized. Two of your floaty facts are true, one is pure bathwater. Nobody quack.
game.prompt: Three things you have found floating somewhere they had no business floating.
